question: Which deities and mantra elements are to be placed with Indrāṇī at the end of kilikilā?
premises: Kapālin is named at the end of kilikilā
inference: Indrāṇī, Vaṭuka, eṃśa, and Kapālin are to be included at the end of kilikilā.
uncertainties: Exact parsing of vaṭuka eṃśa is uncertain
plain_english: Include Indrāṇī, Vaṭuka, eṃśa, and Kapālin at the end of kilikilā.
